changeSet.comment:
Wave 2 cleanup: removes 20 legacy tests seeded by 2.3.x.x/new_tests.xml (COVID PCR, COVID Antibody IgM/IgG, Dengue PCR, HIV Infant Viral Load, HIV Viral Load, Hepatitis C Viral Load, Hepatitis B Viral Load) and the Respiratory Swab sample type which is exclusively owned by these tests.
NOT deleted: Sputum, Fluid, Serum, Plasma, DBS sample types — these are shared by OCL import, TB tests, and RetroCI Java code. NOT deleted: 'Inconclusive' and 'Invalid' dictionary entries — shared across multiple test groups and cannot be proven exclusive to these tests.
Safety: MARK_RAN if any patient analysis data exists for these tests.
